storyline_causality_quote: The test with contract workers began without properly telling users.
entertainment_quote: The deeper twist is that, just when we expected AI to replace humans, humans had entered AI’s backstage, so as AI phone calls become more common, it will likely matter to tell users who is on the other end, not only how smartly the phone can talk.
comprehension_quote: If callers think AI is listening, they decide whether to speak on that basis.
thinness_quote: Inside the company, privacy concerns were raised: users’ sensitive information might reach staff without users meaning to share it.
